title: Three People Outside House, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo, California
description: A black and white outdoor snapshot from around 1950 depicting a man standing casually between two women next to a multi-story residential house. The house features shingled upper walls and horizontal siding. A tall palm tree and foliage in the background suggest a sunny, suburban setting, likely in California. The group's attire and hairstyles reflect everyday mid-20th-century fashion in post-WWII America.
